notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback, by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands to gain an additional turn.
Slogurk triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it to your hand.
Slogurk triggers, returning three Islands from graveyard to your hand.
Play the three Islands.
Cast Slogurk for {1}{U}{G}.
Pass turn.
Repeat.
